## Install

**On the TV (Android TV / Google TV / TV box):** install `LumaBeam-*.apk` (for example with a USB stick and a file manager, or `adb install`). Open **LumaBeam** — it starts receiving and also starts automatically after the TV reboots.

**On an Android phone (for full screen + sound mirroring):** install the same APK, open it, tap your TV.

**iPhone / iPad / any phone:** no install needed —
- in video apps (Bilibili, Youku, iQIYI, Tencent Video, VLC, …) tap the TV / 投屏 button and pick your TV, or
- scan the QR code on the TV to send photos, videos and music from the browser.

Ad-free, no accounts, no tracking. Everything stays on your local network.
